# **Summary**

This work is part of the sDiv-funded working group led by Jean-Philippe Lessard and Catherine Graham.

Species are not distributed everywhere, but have range limits. Populations are locally adapted to their environment and environments are variable across the range, thus creating an environmental gradient. 
We will investigate the distribution of selection strength, phenotypic variation and heritability across species ranges in Vertebrates, vascular plants and insects.

# **Collaborators**

Colin Garroway, Chloé Schmidt, Michael Gerth, Emily Dovydaitis.
